runtimes.source: Official MariaDB releases

runtimes.source: A single-file database manager

runtimes.source: The classic MySQL/MariaDB web interface

runtimes.label: Ngrok
runtimes.source: Share sites on a public URL (free account needed)

runtimes.label: Cloudflare Tunnel
runtimes.source: Cloudflare quick tunnels, no account needed

runtimes.label: Redis
runtimes.source: Real Redis from the community redis-windows build (Redis has no official Windows build), with redis-cli

runtimes.label: Composer
runtimes.source: PHP's package manager; run composer from the LampRabit terminal

runtimes.label: MySQL
runtimes.source: Official MySQL releases; runs next to MariaDB on its own port

runtimes.label: phpRedisAdmin
runtimes.source: Browse and edit Redis keys in the browser, like phpMyAdmin

runtimes.label: Memcached
runtimes.source: nono303's Windows build of Memcached (no official one exists), checked and repackaged by LampRabit

runtimes.label: Caddy
runtimes.source: Official Caddy releases from GitHub; uses LampRabit's certificates and PHP, not its own

runtimes.label: Java
runtimes.source: Eclipse Temurin JDKs from Adoptium (checksum checked); java, javac and jar work in LampRabit's terminal, with JAVA_HOME set

runtimes.label: Tomcat
runtimes.source: Official Apache Tomcat releases (SHA-512 checked); runs on the active Java and serves Java projects behind your web server

runtimes.label: FrankenPHP
runtimes.source: Official FrankenPHP releases: Caddy with its own PHP built in, so LampRabit's PHP versions and extensions don't apply to its sites

runtimes.label: PostgreSQL
runtimes.source: PostgreSQL built from source for every OS by theseus-rs (checksum checked); psql and pg_dump work in LampRabit's terminal

runtimes.label: Python
runtimes.source: python-build-standalone (the builds uv uses, checksum checked); python and pip work in LampRabit's terminal

runtimes.label: phpPgAdmin
runtimes.source: The PostgreSQL web interface in PHP (ReimuHakurei's maintained fork for PHP 8); log in as root without a password

runtimes.label: pgAdmin
runtimes.source: PostgreSQL's official admin tool from PyPI, in its own Python environment (needs Python 3.10–3.14); LampRabit's PostgreSQL is added for you

runtimes.label: MongoDB
runtimes.source: Official MongoDB Community Server releases (checksum checked); each major version keeps its own data folder

runtimes.label: mongosh
runtimes.source: MongoDB's shell from its GitHub releases; mongosh works in LampRabit's terminal, and MongoDB uses it to shut down cleanly

runtimes.label: MongoDB Database Tools
runtimes.source: MongoDB's mongodump and mongorestore (checksum checked); LampRabit's MongoDB backups use them

runtimes.label: MongoDB Compass
runtimes.source: MongoDB's desktop app from its GitHub releases; opens connected to LampRabit's MongoDB

runtimes.label: SQLite
runtimes.source: The sqlite3 shell from sqlite.org (SHA3 checked). PHP has SQLite built in, so projects don't need this to use it; backups use it to copy safely

runtimes.label: ClickHouse
runtimes.source: Official ClickHouse builds from GitHub. Its web console is at /play on its HTTP port
runtimes.unavailable: ClickHouse has no Windows build. Run it in WSL, or use LampRabit on Linux or macOS.

runtimes.label: Neo4j
runtimes.source: Neo4j Community from dist.neo4j.org (checksum checked); runs on Java 21+, Neo4j Browser at neo4j.test

runtimes.label: Meilisearch
runtimes.source: Official Meilisearch Community builds from GitHub (checksum checked); runs in development mode, with its search preview at its URL

runtimes.label: Typesense
runtimes.source: Official Typesense builds from dl.typesense.org (no checksums published). API key: lamprabit
runtimes.unavailable: Typesense has no Windows build. Run it in WSL, or use Meilisearch.

runtimes.label: RustFS
runtimes.source: RustFS from its GitHub releases (checksum checked): S3-compatible, with a web console. Access key lamprabit, secret lamprabit-secret

runtimes.label: Ollama
runtimes.source: Ollama's own builds from GitHub (a large download). Models go to LampRabit's data folder; the ollama command uses this server

runtimes.label: MinIO
runtimes.source: MinIO's last release (October 2025), built from its source by LampRabit's CI: the project is archived, so there are no security fixes. Access key lamprabit, secret lamprabit-secret

runtimes.label: Elasticsearch
runtimes.source: Official Elasticsearch archives (SHA-512 checked) with their own Java; one node, security off, 512 MB of memory

runtimes.label: OpenSearch
runtimes.source: Official OpenSearch archives (SHA-512 checked) with their own Java; one node, security off, 512 MB of memory

runtimes.label: n8n
runtimes.source: n8n from npm, installed into its own folder and run on NVM's Node.js (24 or newer). Editor at n8n.test

runtimes.label: RabbitMQ
runtimes.source: Official RabbitMQ releases (checksum checked) with the management console (user guest, password guest)

runtimes.label: Erlang
runtimes.source: Official Erlang/OTP builds for Windows (checksum checked)

runtimes.label: Go
runtimes.source: Official Go releases from go.dev (checksum checked); go and gofmt work in LampRabit's terminal

runtimes.label: Rust
runtimes.source: Rust stable through rustup, kept inside LampRabit's folder (not your ~/.cargo), with the GNU toolchain, which needs no Visual Studio

runtimes.label: Maven
runtimes.source: Apache Maven from Apache's mirror (SHA-512 checked); mvn works in LampRabit's terminal on the active Java

runtimes.label: Gradle
runtimes.source: Gradle's official distribution from services.gradle.org (SHA-256 checked); gradle works in LampRabit's terminal on the active Java

runtimes.label: Git
runtimes.source: MinGit, Git for Windows' official portable build (SHA-256 checked), for the Git tab, Clone and LampRabit's terminal. A Git already installed on the computer works too
